text: そうか　ボスに　あおうって　いうのかい

structure.jp: ボスに　あおうって
structure.en: that you mean to meet the boss

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: This ending says what someone has decided to do; for verbs like あう it shows up as おう. あおう = 'I'll meet him'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と and works like quote signs around what is said or thought. あおうって = '(saying) "I'll meet him"'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい is a soft, familiar way for a man to ask a question, and の before it asks for an explanation. いうのかい = 'is that what you're saying?'
